scripts.build: cd packages/tui && npm run build && cd ../ai && npm run build && cd ../coding-agent && npm run build
scripts.check: biome check --error-on-warnings . && npm run check:biome-semantic-safety && npm run check:release-binary-benchmark && npm run check:pinned-deps && npm run check:typescript-toolchain && npm run check:ts-imports && npm run check:coordinator-boundaries && npm run check:kernel-layer && npm run check:multi-tenancy-census && npm run check:clone-config && npm run check:clones && npm run check:contract-doctrine && npm run check:precommit-gate && npm run check:architecture-map && npm run check:output-reduction && node scripts/run-tsc.mjs --noEmit && npm run check:browser-smoke
scripts.check:precommit-gate: node --test scripts/precommit-staged.test.mjs scripts/github-origin.test.mjs scripts/ci-status.test.mjs scripts/release-staging.test.mjs scripts/release-recovery.test.mjs scripts/release-ci-proof.test.mjs
scripts.check:output-reduction: node --conditions=pi-source --test scripts/output-reduction-census.test.mjs scripts/check-output-rules.test.mjs && node --conditions=pi-source scripts/check-output-rules.mjs && node --conditions=pi-source scripts/output-reduction-census.mjs --corpus packages/coding-agent/test/fixtures/tool-output/corpus.json --gate "{\"rg\":0.25,\"cargo check\":0.6,\"biome\":0.6,\"gh api\":0.5,\"tsc\":0.5,\"eslint\":0.2,\"make\":0.5,\"go build\":0.5,\"fpc\":0.5,\"php\":0.3,\"ruff check\":0.5,\"python\":0.5}"
scripts.check:provider-regressions: npm exec --workspace packages/ai -- vitest run test/provider-accounting.test.ts test/xai-oauth.test.ts test/anthropic-stream.test.ts test/antigravity-provider.test.ts && npm exec --workspace packages/coding-agent -- vitest run test/provider-request-secrets.test.ts
scripts.version:patch: npm version patch --workspaces --no-git-tag-version --workspaces-update=false && node scripts/sync-versions.js && npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts
scripts.version:minor: npm version minor --workspaces --no-git-tag-version --workspaces-update=false && node scripts/sync-versions.js && npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts
scripts.version:major: npm version major --workspaces --no-git-tag-version --workspaces-update=false && node scripts/sync-versions.js && npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts
